title: campsis pandorana
intro: Campsis pandorana, commonly known as the Chinese trumpet creeper, is a type of flowering plant in the Bignoniaceae family. This plant is known for its vibrant orange-red flowers and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Campsis pandorana include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve cardiovascular health due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve blood circulation, with bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
